dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Progressive myoclonic ataxia due to a neurodegenerative cerebellar disorder, most consistent with sporadic adult-onset cerebellar ataxia with cortical myoclonus

ALTERNATIVES:  
1. Multiple-system atrophy, cerebellar type (MSA-C)  
2. Genetic spinocerebellar ataxia with myoclonus  
3. Functional (psychogenic) movement disorder with superimposed ataxia
